title: Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The learner analyses why CRE is studied (to know God, grow in sound moral and religious values, live responsibly, respect others), how it promotes values, and compiles five values for responsible living (honesty, respect, responsibility, love, integrity).

floor.prerequisite: Knows the values in the Ten Commandments.
floor.question: Which value does "do not steal" teach?

representations: a web: why we study CRE
value cards with an action each
steps: Say how each shows at home and school.

board.do: Draw a web with "CRE" in the middle.
Point at an empty arm of the web.
Wait for the learner to give a reason.
Compile five values on the board.

misconceptions.repair: Ask learners to write how one CRE lesson changed what they did that week.

misconceptions.ask: Where should we show the values learnt in CRE?
misconceptions.repair: List places values are needed: home, school, the matatu, online. Match a value to each.

listen_for: Getting your own way at any cost
misconceptions.ask: Which is a value learnt in CRE?
misconceptions.repair: Sort cards into values and vices; give each value an action that shows it.

listen_for: Learning rules so as to avoid punishment
misconceptions.ask: What is Christian Religious Education mainly about?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what each lesson taught about God, then what it taught about living. Both together are CRE.

checks.question: Name one reason for studying CRE.
checks.answer: To grow in good values (to know God)

checks.question: Compile five values for responsible living.
